name: audit-registry-snapshot-layout-assumptions
title: Evaluate remaining skill_review layout assumptions for snapshot inclusion
description: Speculative follow-up. skill_review.py still derives FIRST_PARTY_REMOTES, discovery globs, and adapter paths from code layout rather than the registry snapshot. Decide whether any of these are registry data that belong in the versioned snapshot (extending schemaVersion) or should stay layout-derived. Read-only assessment first; only expand the snapshot schema if it removes a real layout coupling.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Read-only assessment; 'no schema change' is a complete outcome, not a failure to deliver. Three candidates assessed separately: FIRST_PARTY_REMOTES (:39-42), adapter paths (:442-446), and discovery globs / IGNORED_DIRECTORIES (:43+). Adapter paths are the strongest candidate; FIRST_PARTY_REMOTES has a self-reference problem (a pack-shipped snapshot cannot authoritatively assert that pack's own first-party remote -- a fork would claim its own). Any schemaVersion 2 is a coordinated two-repository migration gated by SUPPORTED_REGISTRY_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA_VERSIONS (:31), which hard-fails unsupported versions.
